ORDER SHORTENING TIME TO OBJECT TO STIPULATION AND AGREEMENT

Issue Date: October 7, 2026                                 Effective Date: October 7, 2026

       On October 7, 2026, Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (Evergy Metro),

the Staff of the Commission (Staff), and Renew Missouri Advocates filed a Non-Unanimous

Programs Stipulation and Agreement.

       Commission Rule 20 CSR 4240-2.115(2) provides that parties have seven days to

object to a non-unanimous stipulation and agreement. The seven days for parties to respond

to the program stipulation and agreement is beyond the scheduled evidentiary hearing and

places objections due on October 14, 2026. Accordingly, the time for objections to the

stipulation and agreement will be shortened.

       THE COMMISSION ORDERS THAT:

       1.     Any objections to the Non-Unanimous Programs Stipulation and Agreement

must be filed no later than midnight on October 9, 2026.

       2.     This order is effective when issued.

                                          BY THE COMMISSION



                                          Nancy Dippell
                                          Secretary
